adapter.description: Any send through this bot account with nobody watching, from a schedule, a Bot or a plugin, may reach these conversations and members. Anyone else gets a draft or waits for approval.
adapter.title: Recipients reachable unattended

empty: No one is listed. A send with nobody watching asks first.

integrationAccount.description: Any GitHub write through this account with nobody watching, from a workflow, a plugin or a scheduled run, may reach these repositories. A write to any other repository waits for a person to approve it.
integrationAccount.title: Repositories writable unattended

invalid.conversation: That is not a conversation key. It looks like platform:bot:chat.
invalid.mail: That is not an email address.
invalid.person: Enter the member's id on this platform.
invalid.repository: That is not a repository. Use owner/repo, host/owner/repo or its URL.
invalid.site: That is not a web address. Use one starting with https:// or http://.

noneKnown: No conversation of this account has reached this device yet. Paste a conversation key instead.
noneKnownRepository: No repository has reached this device yet. Type owner/repo instead.
otherAccount: That conversation goes through another bot account.

placeholder.conversation: Search, or paste a conversation key

saveFailed: Could not save the recipient list: {reason}
siteNote: A listed site takes this Bot's browser submissions (a form, a post) with nobody asking. Data a page sends in its address is not checked.
siteOrigin: Adds {origin}, every page of that site.
